intent: Decompose the oversized SADHANA operator-control module into one private protocol module and one stable public authority/custody facade without changing protocol behavior, exception identity, import compatibility, or authority boundaries, while making both resulting modules satisfy the hard 1000-line module budget.

negative_controls.name: facade-and-authority-boundary-regressions
negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_operator_control.py -k 'public_facade_preserves_pre_split_protocol_surface or public_module_preserves_filesystem_exception_identity or module_has_no_store_database_provider_tool_or_systemctl_boundary or split_modules_stay_under_module_budget'

commit.message: refactor(control): split operator protocol from authority facade

interface_mismatches: The pre-split facade exposed protocol defaults and validation constants as module globals even when they were absent from __all__; scripts/runtime/sadhana_control_api.py imports DEFAULT_NORMAL_INBOX and DEFAULT_EMERGENCY_INBOX directly, so a split that preserves only __all__ breaks API collection.
Protocol types and filesystem exceptions cross module boundaries by identity; wrappers or duplicate definitions would change isinstance, callback validation, replay handling, and exception matching.
The authority reconciler must remain free of canonical stores, providers, tools, and systemd while the private protocol module must remain equally authority-free.
A module-budget repair is acceptable only when all pre-split classes and functions remain text-identical and the stable public module continues to re-export every legacy protocol global.
honest_blockers: This packet proves local source, import, and focused behavioral compatibility only; it does not prove a deployed control service, live supervisor application, or an observed external effect.
The private protocol module is an implementation dependency, not a new authority owner or public control surface.
Mission Control's read-only projection did not contain campaign sadhana-10-20260823, so no runtime mission-state claim is made from this work.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the protocol extraction, facade aliases, frozen compatibility and module-boundary fixtures, and this packet together. No schema, database, deployment, host, provider, or external effect is introduced by this refactor.
